people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.
translations.bsb: Hear this word, O house of Israel, this lamentation I take up against you:
translations.kjv: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
translations.asv: Hear ye this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.
